test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table in a manner that two persons are sitting on each side of the table. They all are facing the centre of the table, thus each person sitting on a side is facing another person sitting on the opposite side of the square. Both B and C are immediate neighbours of A. E faces one of the immediate neighbours of A. H faces C. F and G face each other. Who is sitting opposite D?
solution:
**__EXPLANATION:__** 

1. H faces C.

2. Both B and C are immediate neighbours of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3916840aa214f76ba81c94fe0e8c15e8c1370c5e7eb7b37ba4b1bc4344ce0a8.png] 

3. E faces one of the immediate neighbours of A.

(Here, H already faces the C so E faces only B)

4. Both B and C are immediate neighbours of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5dc5eceea85512b92b33904c7a241e865760abcbb0b2431ae126d638af5d312.png] 

F and G face each other. So D faces towards A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/638fd69921adcedfe40bc7bf3fb6550d25d45a0fcbba8dd797ee86b36ddd541a.png] 

Hence** "A"** is the correct answer.
